FAQ

What is the best AI receptionist for a busy HVAC season?If your volume swings a lot, a flat unlimited plan like NextPhone (from $199/mo, third-party report) avoids overage. For steadier volume, Rosie's $149/mo tier includes 1,000 minutes.
Can an AI receptionist book service calls into my scheduling software?Some can. Check the integration with your field service app before you buy. Jobber also sells its own AI receptionist as an add-on.
How long does setup take?Rosie lists 10–20 minutes, My AI Front Desk 30–60 minutes, and NextPhone and Smith.ai about 1–2 hours.
